title: 植物为什么要关起来（国内版）

points.K2: 原因一：引进材料带病虫
points.K14: 一级保护人，二级保护环境
points.K19: 控制育种：挡住外来花粉
points.S2: 离开隔离区，别带出病虫

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一间带纱网的隔离温室前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a screened isolation greenhouse.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：植物为什么要关起来。

shots.scene: 一株植物被罩在透明罩里
shots.prompt_en: A potted plant sits under a clear dome cover. No people.
shots.narration: 也就是植物封闭。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一袋外地带回的种苗，兴冲冲走向田边
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a bag of seedlings from far away and hurries toward a field.
shots.narration: 阿杰从外地带回一批种苗，想直接种。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着隔离温室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at the isolation greenhouse.
shots.narration: 小研说：先进隔离温室，查清再说。

shots.scene: 种苗叶背露出几个小虫和病斑图标
shots.prompt_en: Small insect and leaf-spot icons appear under the seedlings' leaves. No people.
shots.narration: 种苗里，可能藏着看不见的病虫。

shots.scene: 一株植物在封闭房间里，门外打叉
shots.prompt_en: A plant inside a closed room, with a red X on the path to the outside. No people.
shots.narration: 植物封闭，就是把植物关在设施里，

shots.scene: 检测结果出现两个绿勾后，门才打开
shots.prompt_en: Two green checks appear on a test result, then the door opens. No people.
shots.narration: 确认没病原、没转基因，才能移出。

shots.section_title: 原因一：引进材料带病虫
shots.scene: 一个装种苗的包裹从地球另一端运来
shots.prompt_en: A parcel of seedlings arrives from the other side of a globe. No people.
shots.narration: 从外地引进的种苗，
overlay: 原因一：引进材料带病虫

shots.section_title: 原因一：引进材料带病虫
shots.scene: 包裹里爬出真菌和昆虫图标
shots.prompt_en: Fungus and insect icons creep out of the parcel. No people.
shots.narration: 会带来它自己的病菌和害虫，

shots.section_title: 原因一：引进材料带病虫
shots.scene: 本地农田被病虫感染，钱袋图标缩小
shots.prompt_en: Local crops get infected, and a money-bag icon shrinks. No people.
shots.narration: 传进本地，危害庄稼，造成损失。

shots.scene: 转基因植株从实验室直奔田地，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A transgenic plant icon going straight from a lab to a field, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因植物，不能从实验室直接下田。

shots.scene: 植株先进封闭温室，旁边审批章
shots.prompt_en: The plant first enters a contained greenhouse, with an approval stamp beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 先在设施里封闭研究，获批才能释放。

shots.scene: 转基因花粉飘向本地老品种
shots.prompt_en: Pollen from a transgenic plant drifts toward a local traditional crop. No people.
shots.narration: 花粉飘到本地品种上，

shots.scene: 长出一株杂交后代，带问号
shots.prompt_en: A hybrid offspring plant grows with a question mark tag. No people.
shots.narration: 会长出混了转基因的杂交后代。

shots.scene: 农户举着空白文件，旁边法槌
shots.prompt_en: A farmer-like older man holds a blank document next to a judge's gavel.
shots.narration: 种传统作物的农户，可能会起诉。

shots.scene: 天平一边显微镜，一边法规书
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a microscope on one side and a law book on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 封闭既是科学需要，

shots.scene: 法规书上打勾
shots.prompt_en: A green check appears on the law book. No people.
shots.narration: 也是法律要求。

shots.scene: 七个图标排成一列，像课程目录
shots.prompt_en: Seven icons in a column like a course outline. No people.
shots.narration: 本模块要学这些内容：

shots.scene: 组培室和转基因温室两张蓝图
shots.prompt_en: Two blueprints: a tissue-culture lab and a transgenic greenhouse. No people.
shots.narration: 还有组培设施和转基因温室的设计。

shots.scene: 设施、人员、培训三个图标压着钱币
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a facility, staff and a training cap, sitting on coins. No people.
shots.narration: 封闭要设施、要人手、要培训，很贵。

shots.scene: 本地品种直接种在田里，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A native crop planted directly in an open field with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 本地品种、没做改造，就不用封闭；

shots.scene: 新品种和引进品种进封闭温室
shots.prompt_en: A new variety and an imported variety go into a contained greenhouse. No people.
shots.narration: 新品种、引进品种，才需要封闭。

shots.scene: 四个打勾的小方框
shots.prompt_en: Four small boxes, each getting a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 学完要会四件事：

shots.scene: 小研在空白蓝图上画方框
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sketches boxes on a blank blueprint.
shots.narration: 最后能自己画出封闭设施的草图。

shots.scene: 评估、减缓、绩效三个圆圈循环
shots.prompt_en: Three connected circles rotating in a loop. No people.
shots.narration: 最重要的是这三步：

shots.scene: 三个圆圈托起一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The three circles hold up a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它们是生物风险管理的基础。

shots.scene: 转基因植株被关进封闭温室
shots.prompt_en: A transgenic plant icon placed inside a contained greenhouse. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因植物，一定要封闭。

shots.scene: 一段基因图标上挂着专利锁
shots.prompt_en: A gene segment icon with a padlock tag on it. No people.
shots.narration: 有时防外逃，也是保护研发成果。

shots.scene: 法规书同时罩住一棵树和一个实验室
shots.prompt_en: A law book icon sheltering both a tree and a laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 法律既保护环境，也保护研发者。

shots.scene: 框内生物危害标志，旁边一个人形
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard symbol in a box, with a person outline standing next to it. No people.
shots.narration: 一级封闭，保护的是人。

shots.scene: 植物带着对人有害的病原图标
shots.prompt_en: A plant icon carrying a microbe icon with a human warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 比如植物带着对人有害的病原，

shots.scene: 小研戴好呼吸防护、口罩、手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a respirator, mask and gloves.
shots.narration: 就要用口罩、手套等防护把人隔开。

shots.scene: 外框包住人和标志，框外一棵树
shots.prompt_en: A larger frame around the person and the biohazard box, with a tree outside it. No people.
shots.narration: 二级封闭，保护的是环境。

shots.scene: 温室结构挡住花粉和病原图标
shots.prompt_en: A greenhouse structure blocks pollen and microbe icons from escaping. No people.
shots.narration: 靠设施结构，挡住花粉和病原。

shots.scene: 风暴把玻璃温室的一块玻璃打碎
shots.prompt_en: A storm breaks a glass panel of a greenhouse. No people.
shots.narration: 台风打碎温室玻璃，封闭就被突破了。

shots.scene: 老周拿起电话报告
shots.prompt_en: The older man picks up a phone to report.
shots.narration: 要立即报告主管部门。

shots.scene: 设施周围一圈植物被收集进灭菌袋
shots.prompt_en: Plants in a circle around the facility are collected into decontamination bags. No people.
shots.narration: 收集周围一定范围的植物去污处理。

shots.section_title: 一级保护人，二级保护环境
shots.scene: 红框盾牌护人，橙框盾牌护树
shots.prompt_en: A red shield protects a person outline, an orange shield protects a tree. No people.
shots.narration: 记住：一级保护人，二级保护环境。
overlay: 一级保护人，二级保护环境

shots.section_title: 一级保护人，二级保护环境
shots.scene: 转基因植株和引进植株站在框中央
shots.prompt_en: A transgenic plant and an imported plant stand in the centre box. No people.
shots.narration: 这里要关住的，就是这些植物。

shots.scene: 五个图标依次出现
shots.prompt_en: Five icons appear one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 五种情况需要封闭：

shots.scene: 欣欣指着控制育种图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the controlled-breeding icon.
shots.narration: 可见封闭不只为了转基因。

shots.scene: 四个风险图标：基因外逃、蜜蜂、盾牌、购物车
shots.prompt_en: Four risk icons: a gene escaping, a bee, a shield, and a shopping cart. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因植物有四类风险：

shots.scene: 抗虫性状随花粉进入地方品种，蜜蜂受影响
shots.prompt_en: An insect-resistance trait icon travels by pollen into a local crop, and a bee icon looks affected. No people.
shots.narration: 抗虫性状若随花粉扩散，

shots.scene: 本地生态链条图标出现裂缝
shots.prompt_en: A local food-chain icon shows a crack. No people.
shots.narration: 可能扰乱本地生态，所以监管严格。

shots.scene: 上锁的种子柜和打叉的购物车
shots.prompt_en: A locked seed cabinet and a crossed-out shopping cart. No people.
shots.narration: 还要防恶意利用，防市场拒收。

shots.scene: 引进的种苗和生物肥料袋进入检疫站
shots.prompt_en: Imported seedlings and a bio-fertiliser bag enter a quarantine station. No people.
shots.narration: 引进的种苗、活菌肥料，依法要检疫。

shots.scene: 外来入侵植物蔓延，本地品种减产
shots.prompt_en: An invasive plant icon spreads while a local crop's yield bar drops. No people.
shots.narration: 风险是外来入侵，和外来花粉致减产。

shots.scene: 种苗在隔离温室里放了一段时间，日历翻页
shots.prompt_en: Seedlings wait in an isolation greenhouse as calendar pages turn. No people.
shots.narration: 病原可能后期才显，要隔离观察一段，

shots.scene: 分子检测出结果，阳性则进口被叫停
shots.prompt_en: A molecular test result; when positive, an import arrow gets a stop sign. No people.
shots.narration: 做检测，带病原就限制引进。

shots.scene: 组培瓶里的小苗，看起来很弱
shots.prompt_en: Small tissue-culture plantlets in jars, looking delicate. No people.
shots.narration: 组培苗比较弱，没见过田间病虫。

shots.scene: 小苗先进封闭温室，再走向田地
shots.prompt_en: The plantlets move first into a contained greenhouse, then toward the field. No people.
shots.narration: 封闭温室是下田前的过渡站。

shots.scene: 成片同一品种的苗全部感染，蔓延到邻田
shots.prompt_en: A field of identical seedlings all infected, spreading to the neighbouring field. No people.
shots.narration: 同一品种大批种，一病就成片，

shots.scene: 抗性检测打勾后才下田
shots.prompt_en: A resistance test gets a green check before planting in the field. No people.
shots.narration: 要先确认抗性，别连累邻居。

shots.section_title: 控制育种：挡住外来花粉
shots.scene: 两个纯种亲本植株，中间一个杂交符号
shots.prompt_en: Two pure-line parent plants with a cross symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 两个纯种亲本杂交，得到杂交种。
overlay: 控制育种：挡住外来花粉

shots.section_title: 控制育种：挡住外来花粉
shots.scene: 外来花粉被纱网挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: Outside pollen is blocked by a mesh screen. No people.
shots.narration: 外来花粉一混进来，种子就不整齐。

shots.section_title: 控制育种：挡住外来花粉
shots.scene: 一袋杂交种子标着高价钱币
shots.prompt_en: A bag of hybrid seeds with a tall coin stack beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 所以要在封闭中做，杂交种也更贵。

shots.scene: 封闭室里几盆不同品种的苗排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Several pots of different varieties lined up inside a contained room. No people.
shots.narration: 挑战试验：在封闭设施里，

shots.scene: 病原培养皿图标对着植株，部分植株打勾
shots.prompt_en: A culture-plate icon facing the plants; some plants get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 让品种接触病原，选出抗病的。

shots.scene: 病原图标被关在门内，门外打叉
shots.prompt_en: Microbe and insect icons kept behind a closed door, with a red X on the outside path. No people.
shots.narration: 病原和害虫，绝不能带出去。

shots.scene: 一旦泄漏，病斑扩散到大片农田
shots.prompt_en: If leaked, disease spots spread across wide farmland. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦外逃，会扩散到本地庄稼。

shots.scene: 行李箱里藏着种子，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A suitcase with hidden seeds and plants, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 出差旅行，别私自带种子和植物。

shots.scene: 小研把空白申请单交到检疫窗口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a blank application form at a quarantine counter.
shots.narration: 引种要先办检疫审批，

shots.scene: 种苗进入指定隔离圃，挂上登记牌
shots.prompt_en: Seedlings go into a designated isolation nursery with a blank registration tag. No people.
shots.narration: 到货后在指定隔离区种植观察。

shots.section_title: 离开隔离区，别带出病虫
shots.scene: 阿杰从隔离温室出来，鞋底沾着土
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leaves the isolation greenhouse with soil on his shoe soles.
shots.narration: 离开隔离区，鞋底衣服可能带着病虫。
overlay: 离开隔离区，别带出病虫

shots.section_title: 离开隔离区，别带出病虫
shots.scene: 换鞋、脱工作服、查衣物三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: changing shoes, removing a work gown, checking clothing. No people.
shots.narration: 要换鞋、脱工作服，检查身上。

shots.section_title: 离开隔离区，别带出病虫
shots.scene: 植株和土壤带出门被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A plant and a soil bag carried out the door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 植株、土壤不经处理，不带出门。

shots.scene: 老李检查温室的防虫网和门帘
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the greenhouse insect screen and door curtain.
shots.narration: 防虫网、门帘是挡病虫的屏障。

shots.scene: 网上一个小破洞被红圈标出
shots.prompt_en: A small hole in the insect mesh is circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 破个小洞，害虫就能进出。

shots.scene: 破洞补好，巡查表打勾
shots.prompt_en: The hole is patched and a blank inspection sheet gets a check. No people.
shots.narration: 定期巡查，发现破损马上修补。

shots.scene: 封闭温室里一台喷雾器和警示牌
shots.prompt_en: A sprayer inside a closed greenhouse with a warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 封闭温室不通风，施药更要小心。

shots.scene: 小研戴好防护口罩、手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a respirator, gloves and goggles.
shots.narration: 按标签要求戴好防护，

shots.scene: 门口挂牌，时钟转过，人才进入
shots.prompt_en: A sign hangs on the door, a clock hand turns, then the door opens. No people.
shots.narration: 施药后挂牌，过了间隔期再进。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁：透明罩下的植物、两层盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside a plant under a dome and two layered shields.
shots.narration: 封闭：一级护人，二级护环境。

shots.scene: 五种情形图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Five situation icons in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因、引进、组培、育种、挑战试验。

shots.scene: 破碎玻璃、电话、灭菌袋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a broken glass panel, a phone, and decontamination bags. No people.
shots.narration: 封闭被突破，立即报告、清理。

shots.scene: 检疫单、鞋套、防虫网、喷雾器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a quarantine form, shoe covers, an insect screen and a sprayer. No people.
shots.narration: 引种检疫，防带出，护网，施药防护。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本封面空白的指南
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a guidebook with a blank cover.
shots.narration: 下一节，讲封闭要遵守的指南。

shots.scene: 欣欣在隔离温室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the isolation greenhouse door.
shots.narration: 该关的关好，我们下次见！
